name: MinerU
description: Converts PDFs, Office documents, and scanned pages into LLM-ready Markdown or JSON, preserving tables, formulas, and reading order for agent pipelines.

skills.name: Layout Parsing
skills.description: Detects columns, headers, and figures to reconstruct correct reading order from complex multi-column documents.

skills.name: Table and Formula Extraction
skills.description: Recovers tables as structured markup and mathematical formulas as LaTeX rather than flattening them into text.

skills.name: Batch Conversion
skills.description: Processes large document sets into Markdown or JSON through the CLI or hosted API for retrieval pipelines.
